# DeepL Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that translates text with DeepL: translate between 30+ languages with optional formality control, list supported languages, and check character usage. Translation is read-like — no confirmation needed — but usage counts against your character quota, so batches are kept reasonable. DeepL has a free plan (500k characters/month); free-plan keys end in `:fx` and use the free API host by default. Honest note: machine translation can be wrong — flag this when the output will be published or used in legal, medical, or brand contexts. Draft: written from DeepL's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
